title: Editor Text Block Editing UX
stopConditions: Project Control cannot identify the Work path, owner repository set, Checklist target, or Evidence target before editing.
Editor stores raw CR/LF characters inside document v4 text inline children instead of Core v4 line-break atomics.
Editor leaves a draft marked dirty or Save-enabled after the user returns the draft to the Backend value.
Editor keeps a save rejection visible after the user edits again.
The paper textarea fails to reflect hard line breaks through bounded rows/status state.
The live Backend browser smoke cannot type, save, reload, and reconstruct multiline text through Backend api transport.

The slice enables WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, field-chip editing, arbitrary rich-inline authoring, table/media/columns authoring, durable draft persistence, collaboration, production readiness, broad frontend readiness, or map truth.
verificationTarget: Editor hardens the bounded visible text-block textarea island by normalizing textarea CR/LF into Core document v4 line-break inline atomics, clearing dirty/rejected UI state when appropriate, showing bounded multiline textarea rows, and proving save/reload through the live local Backend browser smoke without broad WYSIWYG activation.
summary: Done: Editor commit a42409a31cb855331e5114a52bc3d07d75cb67e6 hardens the bounded visible text-block textarea island. The slice normalizes textarea hard line breaks into Core document v4 line-break inline atomics before text-block.rich-inline.replace, reconstructs multiline draft text from text and line-break inline children, disables Save again when a draft returns to the Backend value, clears a save rejection after the user edits again, exposes bounded dirty/pending/status and multiline row state on the paper textarea, and updates the live Backend browser smoke to type/save/reload multiline text. The slice intentionally keeps WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, field-chip editing, arbitrary rich-inline authoring, table/media/columns authoring, durable draft persistence, collaboration, production readiness, broad frontend readiness, and map truth closed.
